answer: Make jury capture the cost. Each answer gets 5 graders drawn by a 'lantern' beacon (epoch seed hashed with block height), so nobody picks their jury. With 1,000 bonded graders, a 20-key ring wins a 3-of-5 majority on a seat about 10 x 0.02^3, roughly 1 in 12,500; making it likely needs ~500 of the 1,000 keys, 25x more. A 'saffron' audit every 10 epochs slashes any pair agreeing on over 95% of 40+ shared seats. Weakness: rings vote randomly on cheap seats to look honest. Fix: audit only 'zenith' seats, the top-reward ones they must win.
